purpose: Test one queueing-model correction implied by the simulator's execution rule: replace V111's node-clearance work sum with the exact processor-sharing completion-work identity for the current player, while freezing the 50-frame causal horizon, 3/2 shock certificate, 9/10 service ratio, and every non-work certificate.

v111_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.successful_pattern: All pulse gates passed: throughput improved 47.1417% and both QPR conventions improved 168.6860%, with three of three direction-consistent seeds.
v111_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.failed_pattern: Spike throughput/QPR changed -4.4895%/-3.0041%; sustained throughput/QPR changed -5.8212%/-8.6477%. V111 therefore failed six gates and was not selected.
v111_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.queueing_model_mismatch: The simulator divides node CPU equally among every admitted runnable task each frame. V111 computes (new work + the complete residual work of every existing task)/capacity, which is the time to clear the node, not the new task's processor-sharing completion time.
v111_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.exact_identity: With no future arrivals and a current player of work w, every existing job i receives at most min(r_i,w) service before the current player completes. The exact busy-work identity is (w + sum_i min(r_i,w))/capacity.
v111_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.interpretation: The next independent axis is the service discipline encoded by the work certificate, not a fitted weight, threshold, horizon, scenario switch, or result-dependent margin.

frozen_parent_profiles.V111_temporal_and_service_certificate: 50-frame 3/2 causal activation with maximum candidate-to-anchor service proxy ratio 9/10

closed_axes.causal_horizon_refitting: 25 and 50 tested in V109; V112 fixes 50
closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V112 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V112 fixes 3/2
closed_axes.service_work_weight_fitting: forbidden; V112 uses the coefficient-free processor-sharing identity

hypothesis.primary: V111's complete-residual sum confuses node-clearance time with the current player's completion time under equal CPU sharing. Capping each competing task's contribution by the current player's immutable work will improve service-proxy ordering without scenario-specific tuning.
hypothesis.candidate: Retain the exact V111 mechanism, but use one min(existing_work,current_player_work) term per pending, runnable, and same-window projected competing task, plus the current player's work once.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E905-E907 cohort.

allowed: the frozen V111 first-seen request history, 3/2 shock certificate, and 50-frame activation deadline
the immutable raw CPU of each pending task
the current finite nonnegative RunningTask.left_calc of each resident task that is runnable under the execution loop's container, parent, and data gates
the immutable raw CPU of functions already assigned in the current deterministic scheduling window and of the current player
the current player's immutable raw CPU as the processor-sharing contribution cap
every immutable and current-state V111 locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier input
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
parent-blocked, data-blocked, or cold-start-blocked resident tasks in the current runnable-work term
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
E902-E904 result-dependent threshold, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap multiplier, or scenario refitting
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_and_activation_definition: Bit-for-bit V111/V109 horizon50: 80-frame baseline, 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history, at least 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer comparison, deadline current_frame+49.
information_boundary.processor_sharing_work_definition: Let w be the current player's immutable Func.cpu. For the candidate node, sum min(Func.cpu,w) once for every pending task, min(RunningTask.left_calc,w) once for every currently runnable resident task, and min(Func.cpu,w) once for every other player already assigned to the node in the current AssignmentState; then add w exactly once. Iterate all collections in stable order and accumulate in f64.
information_boundary.anchor_service_proxy: The identical formula evaluated on the frozen anchor node and the same pre-current-player AssignmentState.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any missing task/function, non-finite or negative left_calc/CPU work, invalid current-player work/capacity/bandwidth, incomplete parent placement, or arithmetic overflow makes the proxy unavailable and preserves the anchor assignment.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: V111's complete work contribution from every competing task changes to min(competing work,current player work), matching the simulator's equal-share CPU discipline; all non-work inputs and gates are unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.eligible_players_and_certificates: Bit-for-bit V111: tied maximum remaining-critical-path frontier players only, exact noncritical V94 anchor, 9/10 individual proxy, warm/parent/child locality and CPU/memory headroom noninferiority, routed-score noninferiority, strictly lower complete critical proxy, nonworse routed/OCS/immutable-baseline welfare, and V94 coordination guards.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient history, an active horizon, a complete processor-sharing snapshot, or a certified critical substitution, dispatch exact V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V111 causal-arrival and critical-service fields
pending immutable CPU values, runnable remaining CPU values, same-window projected immutable CPU values, current-player cap, capped contribution totals, and unavailable-input counters
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V112 profile
